The negative large-degree tail then forces at most m strict superlevel components, even allowing touching zeros. Gamma(shape alpha+1) weak convergence of rescaled Beta(k+1,alpha+1) laws, for scales K_j=L^(2j), gives strict m separated peaks and m-1 low valleys for large L at every alpha and c. Independent quadrature, exact arithmetic and numerical witness checks passed 55 tests; finite checks do not replace the analytic proof.

value.rationale: For geometric spectral concentration in analytic weighted Bergman spaces, the number of disconnected frequency bands above any performance threshold is controlled exactly by the number of radial annuli, independent of their precise positions or the Bergman exponent. The count cannot be improved at any threshold because an explicit multiscale construction attains all m components. The theorem is a complete structural capacity statement for the beta-eigenvalue family, not just numerical recomputation. It is related to an earlier Fock plateau theorem but addresses the distinct disk-boundary beta/gamma spectral regime and threshold superlevel geometry.
